subject.title: Deprecation notice: flat/scalar streaming config keys and resolveGroupIntroHint removal (2026.7.3 train)

question: Has a stable release containing the streaming deprecation warnings shipped with enough migration time to approve the removal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107656?
rationale: Removing a public plugin compatibility surface is intentionally release-gated, and source inspection cannot decide whether the ecosystem notice interval is operationally sufficient.

options.title: Wait, then land removal
options.body: Keep this issue and the fallback active until a stable warning release has shipped and affected high-impact packages have had a practical migration window.

options.title: Extend the compatibility window
options.body: Retain the fallback beyond the 2026.7.3 train if package migration evidence remains incomplete or a stable warning release is delayed.

recommendation.title: Wait, then land removal
recommendation.body: Keep this issue and the fallback active until a stable warning release has shipped and affected high-impact packages have had a practical migration window.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the tracker and the linked compatibility and removal work, so they have the strongest available context for the release gate.
